question_text: If the cube roots of unity are 1, ω, ω², then find the roots of the equation (x − 1)³ + 8 = 0.

mark_split.label: Write −8 as (−2)³ and take cube roots

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the roots — what the three cube roots of −8 are, and how you get x from x − 1.
insider_note: The question asks for the roots, plural: a cubic has three, so all three cube roots of 1 are used. The second mark is adding the 1 back — stopping at x − 1 = −2, −2ω, −2ω² is the usual half answer.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write −8 as (−2)³ and take cube roots
steps.margin_note: First mark. (x − 1)³ = −8 = (−2)³, so x − 1 = −2 times a cube root of 1: x − 1 = −2, −2ω, −2ω². A cubic has three roots, so all three cube roots of 1 are used.

recall.must_convey: That (x − 1)³ = −8 = (−2)³ gives x − 1 = −2 times each cube root of unity: −2, −2ω, −2ω².
accept: x minus one cubed is minus eight which is minus two cubed, so x minus one is minus two times one, omega, omega squared
take the cube root of minus eight and multiply by the three cube roots of unity
x minus one equals minus two, minus two omega, minus two omega squared
cube root teeste x minus one is minus two into one omega omega square
there are three cube roots, the real one and the two omega ones

steps.why: A cubic has three roots. Writing −8 as (−2)³ gives the real cube root; multiplying it by 1, ω, ω² gives all three, because those are exactly the numbers whose cube is 1.
common_mistakes: Writing only x − 1 = −2 and giving one root.
Expanding (x − 1)³ + 8 and trying to factor a cubic.

steps.label: Add 1 to each
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Add 1 to each value: x = −1, 1 − 2ω, 1 − 2ω². Three values of x − 1 give three roots.

recall.must_convey: That the reduced expression is evaluated to x = −1, 1 − 2ω, 1 − 2ω².
accept: evaluate the reduced form and get x = −1, 1 − 2ω, 1 − 2ω²
simplify the powers of omega and the value is x = −1, 1 − 2ω, 1 − 2ω²

steps.why: Each value of x − 1 gives a root when 1 is added back. Three values, three roots.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to add 1 and giving −2, −2ω, −2ω² as the roots.
Dropping one of the three roots.
